posts.title: Are Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor right to call this “end times fascism”?
posts.description: End Times Fascism by Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor argues that a new, insidious fascism has emerged through far-right politics, AI and billionaire power, and sets out what we can do to fight these forces. Though brilliantly written and compelling, the book’s US focus and merging of various issues under the fascism umbrella is limiting, writes Danny Dorling. End Times Fascism:… Read more
